notes.title: v1.22.00 - Bug fixes / tweaks
notes.notes:
Hi all. Not much here, just a couple bug fixes for some edge-cases I found in 3-player/sanma mode.
Hope you're all doing well. :)

notes.title: v1.16.04 - Minor bugfix release
notes.notes: Fixes a problem with claiming a concealed Kong/Kan after declaring riichi.

notes.title: v1.15.08 (Bug fixes)
notes.notes: Fixes a bug related to Furiten in sanma mode, and when one can claim a concealed kan after declaring Riichi. Also a minor text update to one of the tutorials. :)

notes.title: 1.15.03 (Minor Update)
notes.notes: Sanma/3P mode - winning on a replacement tile now awards Rinshan ("After a Kan"... which isn't the best name for the yaku in English!).

notes.title: v1.14.11 - bug fixes, tweaks
notes.notes:
* Han/Fan text fix in pop-ups when clicking on a Yaku name in the score summary panel
* Fix to online play sometimes starting with a blank screen

notes.title: Update for Aug 22
notes.notes: Fixed a bug in scoring ("3 Kongs" could have been scored in certain instances with just 2 kongs...).
